=="Wahr-der"==

Hi there, thanks for the edit on the Warder page. I hadn't seen the mistaken spelling just yet, but it was to be removed either way. Pronunciation of an English word has no place here, due to dialects and national standards. I for one prefer British and so pronounce it [ˈwɔ:də]. Merry Christmas btw, those times are closing in.

[[User:ASisterOfTheBlue|ASisterOfTheBlue]] ([[User talk:ASisterOfTheBlue|talk]]) 14:37, December 20, 2013 (UTC)

<p class="MsoNormal">Indeed, I don't think anyone truly pronounces it 'waar-der', which it seems that that pronunciation would suggest. I hope you enjoy the festive period yourself. :) [[User:Acarna|Acarna]] ([[User talk:Acarna|talk]]) 02:37, December 22, 2013 (UTC)Acarna</p>

==Concerning slowing==

Hi there Acarna, good job adding the Slowing page, I was glad to see it myself. Just one thing; I think you've exaggerated a few things. I'm not editing them because I'm not sure myself, but would rather speak you concerning it. Mesaana should be around 300 years of age, and claiming that 400 was "below middle-aged" is even in the Age of Legends a rather hefty statement, don't you think so? The speculation is fine though, no one really knows how old an Aes Sedai could get, but I don't think 400 was considered middle-aged. Also, I think there needs be some reconstruction of the final sentences. No, Reanne Corly seems slighly old (ca in her sixties) at age 412 because she lacks the Oath Rod, which causes agelessness. A channelling woman of age 300 looks older than Cadsuane Melaidhrin, not because the Oath Rod somehow Slows too, but because it causes agelessness. The two have nothing to do with one another.

[[User:ASisterOfTheBlue|ASisterOfTheBlue]] ([[User talk:ASisterOfTheBlue|talk]]) 16:00, February 24, 2014 (UTC)
